coins.description:
CoinGecko coin ids (the name in the coin page's URL), e.g. "bitcoin",
"ethereum". Shown in this order.

currency.description: The currency prices are shown in, e.g. "usd", "eur", "btc".

sample.description:
Read this file instead of calling the API: a saved
`/api/v3/coins/markets` reply. For tests and demos.

warn_drop.description: Warn when a coin fell at least this many percent in 24 hours. Above 0.

entries.description: Prices and 24-hour change of the coins you pick, from CoinGecko. Warns when a coin falls at least a set percent, or a coin id is not found. Click a coin to open its CoinGecko page. Public API, no key.
entries.name: Crypto prices
